reproduced.problem: Current conversation deletion leaves generation available; a late completion can persist the removed ID again.
reproduced.evidence: Controlled real ChatPanel + ChatController test failed before fix: send stayed enabled and late synthetic answer called save once after delete.
reproduced.fix: Controller remove phase excludes generation/editing and suppresses lifecycle flush for deleting ID. Store mutation queue drains earlier saves before delete. Success opens a fresh empty session; failure preserves original draft. UI duplicate/stale confirmation guards and pending state.

reproduced.problem: FavoritesReady remains false after failed initial read then successful foreground refresh; stale reads can overwrite explicit favorite changes.
reproduced.evidence: Three controlled UI regressions failed before fix. Native UI injects a wrong-type preference only in emulator, repairs it, retries and verifies shared storage.
reproduced.fix: Versioned favorite refresh, explicit retry, ready state on recovery, mutations invalidate old reads and separate favorite errors from AI errors.

reproduced.problem: An old clear-API confirmation can execute after leaving; completed old rename can close a new panel.
reproduced.evidence: Both deferred handler regressions failed before fix.
reproduced.fix: Require live component before starting mutation; only close rename page while it remains alive.

reproduced.problem: 320px / 200% typography squeezes chat title into several lines and message composer into a narrow column.
reproduced.fix: Large-font title and actions use separate rows; full-width input above action row, short placeholder, hide nonessential heading during typing and redundant footer hint at large font. Real IME bounds checked.

validation.realImeComposerGeometry: input/send above IME; >=52/48dp, large title one line and full-width composer
validation.nativeConversationDeletion: synthetic ID deleted, new composer empty, send disabled, no automatic AI
validation.deleteFailureAndLateAi: controlled production handlers/controller, original draft preserved and no late save
validation.uiHarnessCorrection: Android accessibility reports placeholder as edit text; empty-composer check accepts native showing-hint flag and also verifies disabled send. Not a product bug.
validation.crashBuffer: no crash entries at final emulator inspection
validation.ios: source metadata only; no native BYOK or Xcode claim
validation.unchangedCoverage: Native input engine, lexicon, API vault, screenshot pixel editing and backend unchanged; preserve 1.28.0/1.28.1 evidence instead of repeating builds/tests of unchanged paths.

privacy: All UI data, injected preference error and conversation IDs are synthetic in the owned emulator; tests restore preferences/vault and delete only their own chat IDs. Physical device untouched. No chat messages sent or clipboard polling.
